signal-violet.$description: Signal Violet — Primary action fill, active links, brand iconography — the only chromatic color in the system, creating high-contrast urgency against the monochrome canvas

inkstone.$description: Inkstone — Primary headings, body text emphasis, dark surface fills — the dominant dark neutral

graphite.$description: Graphite — Secondary text, dense borders, icon strokes — the most-used neutral

slate.$description: Slate — Muted body text, navigation subtext, secondary borders

smoke.$description: Smoke — Tertiary text, helper copy, light borders

ash.$description: Ash — Muted link text, hairline dividers, inactive borders

mist.$description: Mist — Image and photo borders, very light separators

cloud.$description: Cloud — Card surfaces, FAQ panels, subtle background tints — the soft elevation layer

porcelain.$description: Porcelain — Page canvas, button text on violet fill, primary card background — the dominant base surface

obsidian.$description: Obsidian — Footer fill, maximum-contrast text — used sparingly for the darkest dark

aeonik.$description: Primary brand typeface for all text — geometric sans with weights 500 (medium) for body/UI and 700 (bold) for headlines. The 72px/56px display sizes paired with tight 1.05–1.10 line-heights create architectural headlines that feel constructed rather than editorial. Tracking of 0.075em applies to uppercase eyebrows and headings, giving them a premium, slightly-spaced cadence.

rubik.$description: Minor inline use only — appears in small widget contexts, not the primary system font
